_comment: Drives `tools/stamp_erebor_runes.py --manifest`. Each entry produces one runic PBR triple. Edit + commit; the resulting `_runic` PNGs are art-pipeline outputs and should be committed alongside.

stamps._comment: Carved hex centerpiece on the standard A-family wall. Use for throne-room pillars, gate stones, weathered hero walls.
Same centerpiece, gold inlay variant — Bandos-Warforge hero look for treasure room.
Same centerpiece, mithril variant — top-tier hero piece for throne hall.
Celtic interlace trim, carved into the trim_a1 stone. Tiled horizontally across middle band.
Same trim, bronze inlay — forge / smithy aesthetic.
Same trim, silver inlay — restrained heraldic capitals or formal halls.

_notes: Set `skip: false` once the corresponding mask PNG exists under tools/runes/masks/.
Modes: carved | gold | silver | bronze | mithril (defined in stamp_erebor_runes.py METALS dict + CARVED_* constants).
Placement kinds: 'centered' (scale, center) for hero stamps; 'band' (band_y_start, band_y_end, tile) for trim strips.
Auto-crop is on by default and removes white margins from AI-generated masks. Set `placement.auto_crop: false` to disable.
Mode tuning constants live at the top of tools/stamp_erebor_runes.py. Adjust there if a mode reads too subtle / too dramatic in-engine, then re-run the manifest.
Consider adding overlay-decal entries here later for Tier 2 (alpha-keyed quad meshes), once that authoring path is sorted.
